function.description: Retrieves the execution details of a Business API
function.name: api_getBusinessAPIExecutionDetails

bapiError.description: Returns the error response of the original API  as a string

bapiExecutionId.description: Execution Id of the Business API (UUID)

bapiSyncResponse.description: Returns the actual response of the original API as a string

bapiSyncResponseJson.description: Returns the actual response of the original API  as a json

endTime.description: Execution End Time of the Business API (Date Time Format)

endTimeEpoch.description: Execution End Time of the Business API (Epoch Milliseconds)

runtimeInstanceId.description: Pod Id in which the Business API is executed

startTime.description: Execution Start Time of the Business API (Date Time Format)

startTimeEpoch.description: Execution Start Time of the Business API (Epoch Milliseconds)

status.description: Execution status of the Business API

timeDuration.description: Time taken for Business API Execution (Milliseconds)
